S1214.reason: VCLT Article 7 presumes that heads of State, heads of government and foreign ministers may perform all acts of conclusion, and heads of mission may adopt treaty texts, without producing full powers.

S0587.reason: Universal jurisdiction lets every State prosecute a defined set of grave crimes regardless of territory or nationality; it does not cover every international crime.

S1059.reason: In inter-State arbitration the parties appoint the tribunal; third-party appointment is only a fallback, and a closed roster is not the general rule (A and B are identical).
